summary: 2D surface compositing with an optional clipped path. Selects a source surface and a destination surface from two descriptor arrays a2 and a5 using per-descriptor flag bitmasks at index 6 (bits 1 and 2 give direct pointer candidates; bits 4 and 8 give surfaces obtained through a vtable+60 acquire call). Any acquire or blit failure is stored to *this and returns -1. When clipping is required (a10 == -2 or a2[12] > 8 or a5[12] > 8), the clip rect is applied through the sub-object at this+0x1100 via its vtable slot +0x70; otherwise a direct blit path runs two vtable+36 calls, an AudioPlaybackDispatcher notification, and vtable+40 releases of the temporary surfaces. Clears bit 0x400 of a5[6] and returns 0 on success.

operations.description: Initialize clip mode v12 = (a10 == -2); force v12 = 1 when a2[12] > 8 or a5[12] > 8.
Source surface selection: if a2[6] bit 1 set use a2[2], else if bit 2 set use a2[3]; stored via v26.
Source fallback selection: if a2[6] bit 4 set use a2[4], else if bit 8 set use a2[5]; stored via v27.
When the fallback source pointer v15 is non-null, acquire the surface via its vtable+60 call into v26, store the result to *this, and return -1 on failure.
Destination surface selection: if a5[6] bit 1 set use a5[2], else if bit 2 set use a5[3]; stored via v25.
Destination fallback selection: if a5[6] bit 4 set use a5[4], else if bit 8 set use a5[5]; stored via v28.
When the fallback destination pointer v28 is non-null, acquire the surface via its vtable+60 call into v25, store the result to *this, and return -1 on failure.
Branch on clip mode v12 to select the clipped vs direct compositing path.
Clipped path: build the clip rectangle v31..v34 from a3, a4, a8+a3 and a9+a4.
Clipped path: read the sub-object pointer from this+0x1100 and call its vtable slot +0x70 with (v10, &v31, 1, v25, &v29); store the result to *this and return -1 on failure.
Direct path: build the source rectangle v35 = (a3, a4, a8+a3, a9+a4).
Direct path: call vtable+36 on the source surface v10 with rectangle v35; store the result to *this and return -1 on failure.
Direct path: build the destination rectangle v36 = (a6, a7, a8+a6, a9+a7).
Direct path: call vtable+36 on the destination surface v25 with rectangle v36; store the result to *this and return -1 on failure.
Direct path: notify AudioPlaybackDispatcher(v32, v31, v30, v29, a8, a9, a10, a2[12]).
Direct path: release the temporary surfaces v26 and v25 via their vtable+40 calls.
If the fallback source v27 was used, store the vtable+8 call result on v26 into *this; if the fallback destination v28 was used, store the vtable+8 call result on v25 into *this.
Clear bit 0x400 of the destination descriptor flags a5[6] to mark the operation consumed.
Return 0 on success; every vtable failure path returns -1 after storing the error to *this.

int dst[4] = { a6, a7, a8 + a6, a9 + a7 };

unresolved: The vtable slots (vtable+60 acquire, +36 blit, +40 release, +8 result query, +0x70 clipped blit) are interface contracts on caller-supplied surfaces and cannot be named here.
Semantics of a2[12] and a5[12] depth thresholds (> 8) are external to this function.
Exactly how a2[12] is used by AudioPlaybackDispatcher is caller/interface-specific.
